summary: This component renders a blog post with a header, content, and footer, automatically adding bottom margin when displayed in a list (rather than on its own dedicated page). It composes several smaller specialized components together and uses a custom hook to determine the appropriate styling based on context.

explanations.3: This hook from Docusaurus gives us information about the current blog post context, like whether we're viewing a single post's page or seeing it in a list.
explanations.10: We're destructuring 'isBlogPostPage' from the hook — it's a boolean that tells us if we're on a dedicated blog post page or just viewing it as an item in a list.
explanations.11: If we're NOT on a dedicated blog post page (meaning we're in a list view), add extra bottom margin to space it out; otherwise return undefined so no margin class is applied.
explanations.16: The 'clsx' utility merges the margin class we calculated with any additional className prop passed in, combining them into one string for the container's className.
